analyst.summary: Dr Lal PathLabs keeps growing the old-fashioned way - more tests, more locations, and a richer service mix - with sample volumes up over 12% and a big expansion in labs and collection centers this year. The catch is that profit actually fell in the most recent quarter even as revenue grew strongly, because opening new labs and centers costs money before they reach full capacity. Management expects growth to continue at a mid-teens pace with margins stabilizing, which we see as a believable, non-inflated outlook. The stock is priced at a premium (around 57 times earnings) reflecting its position as the trusted market leader, leaving limited room for a margin misstep.
